title: Member Action Card: Early Payoff of Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)
content:
**Member action card — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)**
**Early payoff of a running agreement: `pay_off_payment_agreement_d76d2954`**

### The rule
Where the tier allows early payoff, the member may pay off a running agreement at any time; the balance is billed back as an early payoff, the tier's early payoff fee, where above zero, is billed as a service fee, and the agreement is completed on the same day. Every tier of Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements) allows early payoff.

### Timing of the payoff figure
The balance billed back on an early payoff is fixed only after every installment of the agreement whose grace period has ended unpaid carries a missed-installment entry on the agreement's ledger.

Put the other way round: while any installment of the agreement whose grace period has ended unpaid lacks a missed-installment entry on the agreement's ledger, the payoff balance is not yet fixed.

### What the action does
One call bills the balance being paid off back onto the member's service bill as an early-payoff entry on the arrangement's ledger, dated today, and completes the agreement the same day: its status becomes completed, its end date is today and its unbilled balance is closed to zero. Afterwards the member sees the agreement as completed and the early-payoff amount on the arrangement ledger.

### Who runs it
Paying off the agreement is the member's own act. The representative unlocks the action with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves — the member — then runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

### Parameters
- `arrangement_id` — reference number of the member's payment arrangement being paid off, as returned by the arrangement lookup and read to the member by the representative. Identifier, as shown.
- `payoff_amount` — balance billed back on the early payoff, in US dollars as a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed.

### Return
A confirmation sentence of the form "Agreement ‹arrangement id› paid off: ‹amount› USD billed back as early payoff (entry ‹entry id›); status completed on ‹YYYY-MM-DD›." The amount is shown with 2 decimals, the entry id is the reference number of the new ledger entry, and the date is today. Receiving this sentence means the payoff was recorded and the agreement completed.

### Card question
*Does an agreement paid off early leave anything to bill later?* No installment remains: the unbilled balance is closed to zero on the day of the payoff.
